notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
*Added a button that takes you to the app store version of the game.
*Added an achievement check on startup. If for whatever reason an achievement triggered in-game but not on steam, it should trigger on steam when you play the game.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a few small bugs.

-Any XP excess from offline progression also gets added.
-Rare treasures will now drop correctly if the player resets the game after acquiring certain rare treasures. 
-Draggin the barrel feels better now.
-Max level up on Mini and Mimic chest is now correct.
-Boss chest displays the correct infomation.
-Fixed wrapping with some text.
-Fixed a bug where XP pop ups would get stuck.

notes.title: Big update - More of... everything!
notes.content:
[b]This update introduces… more! Of pretty much everything.[/b]

[b]-13 More treasure chests![/b]

[b]-ADVENTURER Prestige “Branch.”[/b] This branch of upgrades are all related to treasure chest. More loot from chest, higher reinforced treasure chest chance and 2 complete new treasure chest that have a small chance to spawn but drops a lot of loot.

[b]- +11 More prestige upgrades![/b]

[b]-4 New items in the shop.[/b] 2 Of these items can be used. 1 is a one time purchase and another one is similar to the Mini Chest.

[b]Here are the 4 new items:[/b]
Barrel of gold - A barrel will spawn under the treasure chest. If a gold coin lands inside the barrel, the gold coin will be worth more gold. You can empty the barrel whenever you want, and the gold will be added to the total amount. You can drag the barrel to the position of your choosing.

Mimic Chest - The mimic chest works similar to the mini chest. The mimic chest has a chance to be either an evil or friendly mimic. If it is evil, you receive a negative buff for a short period. If the mimic chest is friendly, you receive a positive buff for a short period. 

Treasure Potion - Another potion! This one adds a 3% treasure drop chance for as long as the potion is active. This potion cannot stack.

Enchanted Hammer - The final item. The enchanted hammer instantly opens any chest, including boss chests and enchanted golden chests. All the loot from the chests are doubled while the enchanted hammer is active.

[b]-9 More treasures. 3 New tiers of rarity.[/b]

[b]-9 More rare treasures. [/b]

[b]-3 New cursors.[/b]

[b]-MAX item purchase button.[/b] You can now max purchase any item by either clicking the MAX button which is located under the total amount of gold, or by holding down CTRL. This will also max level up items and cursors. You can also hold down CTRL to max upgrade the active and passive damage.

[b]-Info tab in settings.[/b] This tab contains some simple info. There is also info about the reinforced chests, enchanted golden chests and boss chests.

-Bug fixes and QOL improvements.

I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Small patch - Bugs and QOL Improvements
notes.content:
-SELL TREASURES. You can now choose to sell your treasures. Treasures will not give a huge amount of gold, but selling can be useful for some treasures that are not used for upgrading items and/or cursors that you do not use.

-PURCHASE MISSING RARE TREASURES. If you have bought all prestige upgrades but is still missing some rare treasures, you can now choose to buy 1 rare treasure for 200 skill points. This button is inside the rare treasures tab, aka. the "cool stuff" button. 

-"+1" Text pop up once a treasure and item is received. Similar to the gold text pop ups. You can now see if a treasure is doubled in value. ("+2" Pop up above treasures received)

-Treasure bags gets auto clicked/collected if a player does not click on it after 5 minutes. This will prevent a huge amount of treasure bags being on screen at once if the player goes afk for a long time.

-2 More info tooltips. Hover over the "I" inside the cursor and store tab to get some basic information. This to help out new players.

Balancing: 
-Some active damage prestige upgrades are stronger.
-Active damage will now scale slightly better with passive damage.
-Reduces the price on a few prestige upgrades.
-Changed how much gold the final chest gives.
-Gave the last 2 chests a bit more health.

-Small bug fixes and small QOL changes.
